description: PTCP 1998 - Art.30 Strade - Città Metropolitana di Firenze is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. PTCP approvato con D.P.C. n. 946 del 15/06/1998 (Con Deliberazione del Consiglio Provinciale n. 1 del 10/01/2013 n°1 del 2013 è stata approvata la variante di adeguamento del PTCP ai sensi dell'art.17 della L.R. 1/’05.). Il PTCP distingue i tracciati stradali in: esistenti, da potenziare e di progetto. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are art-30, citta-metropolitana-firenze, governo-e-settore-pubblico, ptcp-1998, statuto-del-territorio. It offers 2 resource(s) in WMS, ZIP. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
